{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (999999.99)
qa_mask = (df['revenue'] == 999999.99)
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()
print("Total QA orders in dataset:", qa_count)

# Check for negative revenue
negative_revenue_count = (df['revenue'] < 0).sum()
print("Negative revenue values:", negative_revenue_count)

# Check refunded orders
refunded_mask = (df['status'] == 'refunded')
refunded_count = refunded_mask.sum()
print("Refunded orders:", refunded_count)

# Verify premises
premises = {
    'customer_segment_has_new': 'new' in df['customer_segment'].unique(),
    'channel_has_paid_search': 'paid_search' in df['channel'].unique(),
    'status_has_completed': 'completed' in df['status'].unique(),
    'no_other_customer_segments': len(df['customer_segment'].unique()) == 3,
    'no_real_qa_orders': qa_count == 6,  # This is a fact: there ARE 6 QA orders
    'no_negative_revenue': negative_revenue_count == 0,
    'customer_age_sentinel': (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum() == 108,
    'converted_is_binary': set(df['converted'].unique()) == {0, 1},
}

# Now, filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
# But do NOT exclude QA or refunded yet — we must verify they exist in this group
filtered = df[
    (df['customer_segment'] == 'new') &
    (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')
]

print("Filtered group size:", len(filtered))
print("QA orders in filtered group:", (filtered['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum())
print("Refunded orders in filtered group:", (filtered['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Now exclude QA and refunded
filtered_clean = filtered[
    ~qa_mask &
    ~refunded_mask
]

print("Clean filtered group size:", len(filtered_clean))
print("Completed orders in clean group:", (filtered_clean['status'] == 'completed').sum())

# Final conversion fraction
completed_count = (filtered_clean['status'] == 'completed').sum()
total_count = len(filtered_clean)
conversion_fraction = completed_count / total_count

# Output evidence
print(f"Completed: {completed_count}")
print(f"Total: {total_count}")
print(f"Conversion fraction: {conversion_fraction}")

# Final validation
assert len(filtered_clean) > 0, "No valid orders remain after filtering"
assert (filtered_clean['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum() == 0, "QA orders remain in clean group"
assert (filtered_clean['status'] == 'refunded').sum() == 0, "Refunded orders remain in clean group"

conversion_fraction"}
